extracted text: The paper discusses friction stir processing (FSP) applied to modify the microstructure of an as-cast A356 alloy. The high strength of the A356 alloy is mainly derived from the precipitation hardening of fine Mg2Si phases, which is dependent on heat treatment conditions. For T6 treatment, the alloy was solution treated at 540°C for 4 hours followed by artificial aging at 165°C for 5 hours. After FSP, some samples received an artificial aging at 438 K (165°C) for 5 hours.
